messages: Priya: Quick sync 1 1: new compact dashboard iteration attached. Main concerns: contrast of secondary numbers, keyboard access to the filter chips, and screen reader phrasing for the metric grid. Thoughts? Tom: Saw the mock. Secondary numbers look like #7A7A7A on #FAFAFA. That looks borderline. Running a quick contrast calc -> ~4.2:1. We should aim for >=4.5:1 for body text. Also noticed the filter chips are not in DOM order with the visual order because we used CSS reflow; that will confuse keyboard users. Lee: For chips we can keep DOM order consistent and use flexbox reorder only visually. If we must reorder for responsive layout, we should use `aria-flowto` or ensure tab order matches visual order. I prefer keeping DOM consistent. A11yBot: automated-scan: issues found = 5; color-contrast (1), focus-visible (1), list semantics (1), aria-roles (2). Full: https://a11y.redwood/report/1765001111.json Priya: Good catch. On the metric grid: it's visually a table but implemented as cards. Screen readers expect either role=grid or table with headers. Which is better? Tom: If content is tabular (metrics per model x dimension), use `` with `scope` on headers. If it's a loose set of cards, use role=region + aria-labelledby per card. For keyboard navigation between cards we can add `tabindex=0` on the card heading so arrow keys move focus within the grid via roving tabindex pattern. Lee: Regarding focus styles, the current focus ring is a subtle 1px shadow which disappears on some browsers. Recommendation: switch to `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus) ; outline-offset: 2px; }` and also ensure the focus color meets contrast with surrounding surfaces (not just background). Maya: We also had a report of NVDA double-announcing the view change when the route transitions. Could be because we programmatically focus the main region and also trigger an `aria-live` notification. We should pick one approach. Prefer moving focus to main and avoiding duplicate live messages. QA: Adding to checklist: 1) All body text >= 4.5:1, secondary/tertiary >= 3:1 if non-body; 2) Keyboard can tab to: skip link, primary nav, filter chips (in visual order), and first interactive in each card; 3) No focus traps on collapsed panels; 4) Route change moves focus to `main#content` and screen reader hears page name only once. I'll write automation steps for NVDA + VoiceOver. Priya: Small copy tweak request: screen reader label for the metric value should read e.g., "Latency 95th percentile: 120 ms" rather than "95th: 120". So aria-label on the value span -> `aria-label=\"Latency 95th percentile, 120 milliseconds\"`. Tom: Also add `aria-hidden=\"true\"` to decorative svg sparkline to avoid noise. For dynamic updates to the metric (live data), use `aria-live=polite` on a small, offscreen status element and avoid live regions inside each card to prevent verbose announcements. Lee: Implementation notes for virtualized list: emit stable ids for each model (data-model-id) and include `aria-posinset` / `aria-setsize` and `aria-roledescription=\"metric card\"`. Also ensure when keyboard focuses a card that we call `scrollIntoView({block: 'nearest'})` for smoother movement without jumping focus away. Priya: Prioritization: patch release. Owner: Tom for DOM/order changes + focus token; Lee for virtual list a11y + roved tabindex; QA for scripts. Target: PR by 1765600000 (end of sprint). A11yBot: reminder: deploy-time check will fail if contrast < 4.5 for body text. QA: I'll add visual regression snapshots for the compact vs roomy layouts and a keyboard smoke test. Tom/Lee please drop final hex values and the focus token name. Tom: Proposed token updates: `--text-secondary: #2F2F2F` (to hit ~7:1 on #FAFAFA), `--focus: #0066FF`. Pushing a WIP branch now with accessible markup and a skip link at top: `Skip to content` Priya: Thanks all. Let's validate with NVDA+VoiceOver once the branch is up. Reopen thread if anything blocks. :pray:
